claims.text: System: the sexual maturity rating most commonly used = based on Marshall and Tanner (the “Tanner stages”).
claims.quote: The system of sexual maturity rating most commonly used is based on the work of Marshall and Tanner. The stages are commonly referred to as the Tanner stages.
claims.locator: What Are the Stages of Sexual Maturity?

claims.text: Pubic hair stage 1: prepubertal; vellus over the pubis similar to that on the abd.
claims.quote: Pubic Hair Stage 1 Prepubertal. The vellus over the pubis is similar to that on the abdomen.

claims.text: Pubic hair stage 2: sparse growth of long, slightly pigmented downy hair, straight or only slightly curled, mainly @ the base of the penis.
claims.quote: Pubic Hair Stage 2 There is sparse growth of long, slightly pigmented downy hair, straight or only slightly curled, mainly at the base of the penis.

claims.text: Pubic hair stage 3: considerably darker, coarser, more curled; spread sparsely over the pubis.
claims.quote: Pubic Hair Stage 3 The hair is considerably darker, coarser, and more curled. It is spread sparsely over the pubis.

claims.text: Pubic hair stage 4: adult in type, but over a smaller area than in most adults; ⍉yet spread to the medial thighs.
claims.quote: Pubic Hair Stage 4 The hair is adult in type, but the area over which it is present is smaller than in most adults. It has not yet spread to the medial thighs or along the linea alba (in males).

claims.text: Pubic hair stage 5: adult in quality and quantity, classical triangular distribution in females; may spread to the medial thighs.
claims.quote: Pubic Hair Stage 5 The hair is adult in quality and quantity and has the classical triangular distribution in females. It may spread to the medial surface of the thighs.
Breast Stage 1 There is no development. Only the nipple is elevated.

claims.text: Breast stage 2: “breast bud”; areola widens, slightly darkens and elevates; a bud of glandular tissue = palpable below the nipple.
claims.quote: Breast Stage 2 The "breast bud" stage, the areola widens, slightly darkens, and elevates from the rest of the breast. A bud of glandular tissue is palpable below the nipple.

claims.text: Breast stage 3: breast and areola enlarge further w a rounded contour; ⍉Δ of contour b/n the nipple and areola and the rest of the breast.
claims.quote: Breast Stage 3 The breast and areola further enlarge, presenting a rounded contour. There is no change of contour between the nipple and areola and the rest of the breast.

claims.text: Breast stage 4: papilla and areola project to form a 2/2 mound above the rest of the breast.
claims.quote: Breast Stage 4 The breast continues to grow. The papilla and areola project to form a secondary mound above the rest of the breast.

claims.text: Breast stage 5: mature adult stage; the 2/2 mound disappears; some females never progress to stage 5.
claims.quote: Breast Stage 5 The mature adult stage. The secondary mound disappears. Some females never progress to Stage 5.

claims.text: Genital stage 1: prepubertal; penis, testes, and scrotum about the same size and proportions as in early childhood.
claims.quote: Genital Stage 1 Prepubertal. Penis, testes, and scrotum are about the same size and proportions as in early childhood.

claims.text: Genital stage 2: only the testes and scrotum have begun to enlarge; penis still prepubertal; scrotal skin thinner and redder.
claims.quote: Genital Stage 2 Only the testes and scrotum have begun to enlarge from the early childhood size. The penis is still prepubertal in appearance. The texture of the scrotal skin is beginning to become thinner and the skin appears redder due to increased vascularization.

claims.text: Genital stage 3: further growth of testes and scrotum; penis begins to grow, mainly in length.
claims.quote: Genital Stage 3 There is further growth of the testes and scrotum. The penis is also beginning to grow, mainly in length with some increase in breadth.

claims.text: Genital stage 4: penis enlarges further in length and breadth, glans more prominent; testes and scrotum lrger; scrotal skin darker.
claims.quote: Genital Stage 4 The penis enlarges further in length and breadth and the glans becomes more prominent. The testes and scrotum are larger. There is further darkening of the scrotal skin.

claims.text: Genital stage 5: penis, testes, and scrotum adult in size and shape.
claims.quote: Genital Stage 5 The penis, testes, and scrotum are adult in size and shape.
